logical_floor.meaning: One walkable logical floor section and one actor/object anchor.

lattice.meaning: A shared interior intersection surrounded by four occupied floor sections.

north.notes: North wall uses a top rim and underside. It is generated from exposed north floor edges.

south.covered_sections: Every occupied section with an exposed south edge.
south.notes: The south rim crosses the actor anchor of the exposed floor section.

west.covered_sections: Every occupied section with an exposed west edge.
west.notes: The west inner face crosses the actor anchor of the exposed floor section.

composition.opaque: Foreground wall remains visible and the logical entity is marked hidden.
composition.xray: Entity glyph replaces the foreground wall glyph using dim or gray styling while wall metadata remains.
composition.walls_removed: Removing south/west foreground layers reveals the unchanged floor topology and actor anchors.

confirmed_fixtures.purpose: Actor anchor and zero lattice intersections.
Approved north/east background and south/west foreground projection with occlusion.
Approved concave east/south transitions, west/south foreground projection, and incomplete lattice suppression.
Mirrored concave courtyard walls terminating into an interior bridge rim and hanging face.

open_work: Approve additional irregular junctions beyond the L-shape and courtyard bridge motifs.
Define door and corridor transitions per directional wall layer.
Define raised-platform projection using the same topology/layer pipeline.

north_run.description: A contiguous exposed north-edge run shares one top rim and one capped underside.

west_foreground_run.description: A contiguous exposed west-edge run crosses the actor anchor and alternates actor and boundary rows.

concave_east_start.description: An east wall beginning below continuous floor uses a curved inner start before continuing as |/|.

south_foreground_run.description: A contiguous exposed south run crosses actor anchors; its face start depends on whether the run begins at the exterior west edge or at a concave notch.

courtyard_bridge_junction.description: An interior north run flanked by opposing inner walls repaints its rim above them and hangs one foreground face into the courtyard.
courtyard_bridge_junction.detection: Exposed east edge immediately left, exposed west edge immediately right, and empty courtyard cells above the north run.
courtyard_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: Both inner wall caps terminate into the bridge and are cleared beneath its underside.
